LESSON: LOCATION AND SIZE OF THE COUNTY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Built Environments
Topic 1.2: Location and size of the County

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Location and size of the County
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to learn the size and location of a county?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify sub-counties in the county
2. estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify sub-counties in the county

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify sub-counties in the county.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify sub-counties in the county” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify sub-counties in the county” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify sub-counties in the county" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties

Teach
• Today’s focus: estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties” using a school example.
• Model B for “estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify sub-counties in the county
• Model 2: estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify sub-counties in the county
2. Practise: estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Location and size of the County.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to learn the size and location of a county?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify sub-counties in the county
• estimate the size of the county in relation to neighbouring counties
